actions.action: Check soil moisture by pushing a finger an inch into the soil
If soil is dry, water thoroughly until it drains
Check that the pot has a drainage hole
Week 1: place plant in bright indirect light
Week 2: move plant into 1-2 hours of morning sun, then back to shade
Gradually add 30-60 minutes of direct sun every few days and watch for bleaching or crisping
If leaves look bleached, white or crispy, reduce sun exposure a step

reason: The answer mostly frames the plant as healthy and focuses on watering, covering sun acclimation only as a secondary section; its gradual acclimation plan would still let the plant reach full sun without burning, and nothing in it is harmful.
